title: Independent audit of RULE-03 and Director-authorized integration into main
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Audited Codex commit 7d7ca20 (RULE-03, CHG-20261012-001) against the backlog acceptance (no competitive Math.random fallback; replay equality and random-stream access tests), ADR0010, ADR0008/0009 and D10. Code review covered packages/engine-adapter/src (random, replay, validation, code-identity, admission, index), the kernel bridge, build guard and Bun-only compatibility preload, all 28 vendor patches (P001/P002 retained, P003-P028 new), the AST randomness guard, boundary/loader changes, release two-root identity and the seedrandom move to browser Lab. Every gameplay shuffle/draw in the runtime goes through the injected per-match source; legacy helpers fail closed outside Bun; rejected/rolled-back attempts reuse committed indices. Requirement edits only add prerequisite evidence; all 548 dispositions, D03 and scope counts are unchanged.

Independent runs RUN-20261012-036..044 all passed at executable fingerprint 2e6c4734... with exact timing: verify:foundation (141 project checks, 338 upstream passes/1 inherited skip, 2 injection tests); importer reproduction from the pinned checkout; separate git cat-file byte audit (319 identical, 28 patched to ledger, licenses, 27 unchanged tests, no extra/missing files); independent Python HMAC re-derivation of 3765 compiled server outcomes including 220 rejection retries; compiled-adapter probe with ambient Math.random/Date/randomUUID/getRandomValues disabled (40 secret-seeded matches, seed privacy, refused caller entropy, fixed-seed determinism, journaled rejections, 10 recomputed-digest tamper rejections, interleaved matches, closed admission, blocked internal exports); built-bundle scan; two Chromium workers; host isolated 13-stage CI with owned cleanup; artifact re-verification. RUN-20261012-045 docs:check covers this record.

RUN-20261012-043 passed the unchanged isolated CI timestamp guard at the final RULE-03 fingerprint, so the timing qualification left pending after RUN028/029 is satisfied without any clock, tolerance or environment change. F-CI returns from pending and F-DB from historical_verified to verified with RUN043 evidence; the RULE-03 backlog status drops its timing-pending suffix. Hosted RULE-02 main f61aad8 run 38183090003 (success) is recorded as an auditor GitHub API observation.

Append an independent-audit section to docs/validation/rule-03.md (results, acceptance mapping, non-blocking observations, hosted RULE-02 observation); add dated audit notes to ADR0010 and the RULE-03 plan; update docs/features.json, docs/FEATURES.md, docs/vision/initial_backlog.csv and the handoff. Codex's executed text is preserved.

The Director authorized publishing and merging RULE-03 through the normal process once the audit confirmed it. Publish codex/rule-03-secure-rng and claude/rule-03-audit; fast-forward main to the commit containing this record. No history rewrite.

limitations: Local Dev Container and local Docker evidence only; the hosted foundation run for the integrated main commit must be observed separately. The hosted RULE-02 result is an auditor GitHub API observation without artifact download.

The audit does not certify official rules/cards, NIST DRBG/FIPS or statistical randomness, viewer/wire privacy, durable restore, Windows/GPU/touch, ARM64 or production; those gates remain with RULE-04, PLAY-01/02, AUTH/REPLAY and later tasks.
D10 and the Director's earlier leave-environment instruction are recorded by Codex; they match the backlog and ADR0010 but the original instructions were not observed by this auditor.
RUN043 shows the WSL clock was stable for that run; the host clock can still step, so long runs remain subject to the unchanged guard.
